name: Home School Skate
venue: Sportsworld Skate Center, 90 County Road 1223
cost: See Sportsworld for skate session pricing
summary: Sportsworld hosts a daytime skate session geared toward home school families. Lace up and roll during school hours at the rink on County Road 1223.

name: James and the Giant Peach
venue: Cullman High School Auditorium, 510 13th Street NE
summary: A stage show of the Roald Dahl story at the Cullman High auditorium.

name: 40th Annual Ho! Ho! Ho!
venue: Cullman Caring for Kids, 402 Arnold Street NE
cost: See Cullman Caring for Kids for entry details
summary: Cullman Caring for Kids hosts its 40th annual Ho! Ho! Ho! Christmas show. The long running holiday car, truck and motorcycle fundraiser helps local kids in need.

name: Christmas Craft Fair and Vendor Expo
venue: Cullman Elks Lodge 1609, 1525 Brantley Avenue NW
summary: A holiday craft fair with local vendors.

name: Vintage Postcard Collection at Shirley Burden Public Library
venue: Shirley Burden Public Library, 201 Commercial Street
summary: A longtime Hanceville resident shares a vintage postcard collection with the public, including local cards, military cards, old voter receipts and cards from around the world.

name: Free Thanksgiving To Go Lunch at Spirit Life Church
venue: Spirit Life Church, 1650 St. Joseph Drive NW
summary: Spirit Life Church invites the community to pick up a free Thanksgiving to go lunch on Saturday morning.

name: The Great Christmas Pickle Hunt
venue: Participating Cullman Chamber member businesses, downtown Cullman
summary: Find hidden Christmas pickles at participating Chamber businesses, scan the QR code, snap a selfie for the prize drawing, then return each pickle so the next hunter can play. Keep hunting at more shops for more entries.

name: Cullman Veterans Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony and Dinner
venue: Loft 212, 212 4th Street SW
summary: The fourth annual Cullman Veterans Hall of Fame induction honors veterans who served the country and then kept serving their community. To attend, reach out to a local service organization or the committee lead named in the Tribune article.

name: Christkindlmarkt Grand Opening and Pyramid Lighting
venue: Depot Park, downtown Cullman
summary: Cullman Christkindlmarkt opens the season with the Lighting of the Christmas Pyramid, led by the Cullman Community Band. Free admission.

name: Run Run Rudolph
venue: Sportsman Lake Park, 1544 Sportsman Lake Road NW
summary: A holiday evening event at Sportsman Lake Park.

name: Cullman Christkindlmarkt
time: Thu to Sat 11 AM to 9 PM, Sun noon to 8 PM; daily from Dec. 10
venue: Depot Park, downtown Cullman
summary: Alabama German Christmas market at Depot Park from Nov. 19 through Dec. 23. Free admission. Hours are Thursday to Saturday 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. and Sunday noon to 8 p.m., then open daily starting Dec. 10. Grand opening and Christmas Pyramid lighting are Thursday, Nov. 19, at 6 p.m. The Christkindlmarkt Parade is Friday, Nov. 20, at 6:30 p.m., with the tree lighting and fireworks at 8 p.m. Closed Thanksgiving Day.

name: Adoration Sodality Day of Recollection Retreat
time: See the Shrine page for the schedule
venue: Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament, 3224 County Road 548
cost: Open to members and non members
summary: The Poor Clares host a day of recollection with Mass, confession, prayer and the rosary with the sisters, and a Eucharistic Healing Service. Father Daniel Klimek, a Marian theologian and author, is the featured speaker.

name: Christkindlmarkt Parade and Tree Lighting
venue: Depot Park and downtown Cullman, 107 Arnold Street NW
summary: The Christkindlmarkt Parade rolls through downtown at 6:30 p.m. The Christmas tree lighting, light show and fireworks follow at 8 p.m. Free to watch.

name: 24th Annual Winter Wonderland
venue: Sportsman Lake Park, 1544 Sportsman Lake Road NW
summary: Holiday lights and fun at Sportsman Lake Park. Check the calendar for the nights it is open through December 11.

name: Drive Through Food Bank at Spirit Life Church
venue: Spirit Life Church, 1650 St. Joseph Drive NW
host: Spirit Life Church / Cullman Area Chamber calendar
summary: Drive through for a free box of food. No ID is required. Complete a one page form once a year that says you need food help. Volunteers load the box into your vehicle. Held the third Saturday of the month from 9 to 11 a.m. Call 256-739-3326 with questions.

name: Town of South Vinemont Thanksgiving Dinner
summary: A community Thanksgiving dinner hosted by the town.

name: The Nutcracker with Ballet South
time: 2:00 PM and 7:00 PM Nov. 21, 2:00 PM Nov. 22
venue: Betty Leeth Haynes Theatre, Wallace State Community College, 801 Main Street NW
summary: Ballet South brings its yearly production of Tchaikovsky's holiday classic to the Wallace State stage.

name: Festival of Trees
venue: Cullman Wellness & Aquatic Center, 1636 Field Of Miracles Drive
summary: Christmas trees decorated by local school students and the Cullman County Public Library. The opening ceremony is December 3 at 5 PM, and the trees stay on display free from December 4 to 27 during the center's regular hours.

name: Baileyton Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony
venue: Baileyton Town Park, 390 Fire Station Road
summary: Baileyton lights its Christmas tree at Town Park. Gates open at 4:30 p.m., the ceremony begins at 6 p.m., and Santa Claus will be there for pictures with children.

name: Lights of Love Ceremony
venue: Christ Hall at St. John's Evangelical Protestant Church, 512 2nd Avenue SE
cost: Free to attend; tribute lights start at $20
summary: The Cullman Regional Foundation hosts the Dr. Herman C. Ensor Lights of Love Ceremony. Tribute lights on the Cullman Regional Christmas tree honor loved ones and support hospital care, with gifts received by Dec. 4 included in the program.

name: Wallace State Christmas Spectacular
venue: Betty Leeth Haynes Theatre, Wallace State Community College, 801 Main Street NW
host: Wallace State Fine and Performing Arts
summary: Every Wallace State performing arts group shares the stage for a free holiday concert.

name: Senior Christmas Party
venue: The Omniplex, 1634 Field of Miracles Drive SW
summary: The Commission on Aging hosts its Christmas party for seniors at the Omniplex. The Tourism calendar lists it as free.

name: Wreaths Across America Ceremonies
time: 10:00 AM at Cullman Public Cemetery; 2:00 PM at Cullman Memory Gardens
venue: Cullman Public Cemetery and Cullman Memory Gardens
host: Dripping Springs Chapter, Daughters of the American Revolution
summary: The public is invited to wreath laying ceremonies honoring local veterans. Ceremony at 10 a.m. at Cullman Public Cemetery and at 2 p.m. at Cullman Memory Gardens. Sponsors can still fund wreaths for $17 each.

name: A Night at the Masters, Clubhouse Edition
venue: Cotton Creek Venue, 417 3rd Avenue SW
summary: A Masters themed fundraiser for Flourish of Cullman. Check the calendar listing closer to the date for the start time.

name: Chamber Christmas Open House and Cookie Crawl
time: Fri 4 PM to 6 PM with Santa at the Chamber; Sat Cookie Crawl during shop hours
venue: Cullman Area Chamber of Commerce, 301 2nd Avenue SW
summary: The Chamber's annual Christmas Open House starts Friday, Nov. 13, when Santa Claus visits the Chamber building on U.S. 31 from 4 to 6 p.m. and families pick up themed cookie boxes. On Saturday, participating shops in the downtown warehouse district hand out fresh holiday cookies for the Cookie Crawl. The Great Christmas Pickle Hunt follows on Sunday.

name: Cocoa, Cookies and Claus
venue: The Cullman Tribune office, 219 2nd Avenue SE
summary: Families can enjoy hot chocolate and cookies and visit with Santa Claus at The Cullman Tribune office. A Tribune photographer will take a free photo with Santa, and guests are welcome to snap their own pictures too.

name: Pleasant Grove Cemetery Community Cleanup and Fish Fry
time: 8:00 AM cleanup, fish fry at 11:00 AM
venue: Pleasant Grove Cemetery (Colony Community Cemetery)
summary: The Town of Colony invites neighbors to help clean up Pleasant Grove Cemetery on Saturday morning. A fish fry follows the cleanup at 11 a.m. Dress warm, since a freeze is expected that morning.

name: Good Hope Christmas Parade and Christmas in the Park
time: Parade 11:00 AM; Christmas in the Park follows
venue: Parade from Good Hope High School football field along County Road 437 to Good Hope City Hall; Christmas in the Park at Good Hope Municipal Park
summary: This year's theme is Be the Light. The parade steps off at 11 a.m. from the Good Hope High School football field and ends at City Hall, where Christmas in the Park continues at Municipal Park with Santa and free food from the city. Parade entries line up at 10 a.m.; call City Hall at 256-739-3757 for details.
